e.title: pyextremes
e.summary: Python 极值分析库（EVA）：GEV/GPD 拟合、阈值选择、重现期与可视化
e.body: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是极值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）库：广义极值（GEV）与广义帕累托（GPD）分布拟合（含阈值选择）、重现期计算、年最大/峰值超阈值（POT）两种方法、诊断图与可视化。对 RIAA：保险巨灾与极端损失建模——洪水/风暴/热浪等极端事件的频率-强度-重现期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 应用）；与 [[extremes]]（R 侧标准库）互补，R 侧见 [[copula-r]] 的极值 copula 族。
e.verified_note: PyPI 2.5.0 + README 核实：Python EVA 库（GEV/GPD/阈值选择/重现期）；2026-09-17 链接复验：原地址 mhostetter/pyextremes 已 404（GitHub 网页与 API 均 Not Found），该库已转移所有者，source 更新为 github.com/georgebv/pyextremes（新址实测 200、★279、MIT、末次推送 2026-02-19）
e.summary_en: Python Extreme Value Analysis library: GEV/GPD fitting, threshold selection, return periods and visualisation
e.summary_hk: Python 極值分析庫（EVA）：GEV/GPD 擬合、閾值選擇、重現期與可視化
e.body_en: pyextremes (mhostetter/pyextremes, Python 2.5.0) is an Extreme Value Analysis (EVA) library: generalised extreme value (GEV) and generalised Pareto (GPD) fitting with threshold selection, return-period computation, both annual-maxima and peaks-over-threshold (POT) approaches, diagnostic plots and visualisation. For RIAA: modelling of catastrophe and extreme losses — frequency-severity-return-period analysis of floods/storms/heatwaves (concept: [[extreme-value-theory]], applications: [[extremeloss]]); complements [[extremes]] (the R standard); on the R side see the extreme-value copula families in [[copula-r]].
e.body_hk: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是極值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）庫：廣義極值（GEV）與廣義帕累托（GPD）分佈擬合（含閾值選擇）、重現期計算、年最大/峰值超閾值（POT）兩種方法、診斷圖與可視化。對 RIAA：保險巨災與極端損失建模——洪水/風暴/熱浪等極端事件的頻率-強度-重現期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 應用）；與 [[extremes]]（R 側標準庫）互補，R 側見 [[copula-r]] 的極值 copula 族。
